en: You see... I'm the Baron's mistress.
Jewels are like stars fallen to earth.
I never tire of looking at them.
Back again? Good day to you.
Is this shop on your rounds too?
Yes, something like that, I suppose.
I also came hoping to see
you again.
Ahaha... You really are a smooth talker.
That's how you've fooled the ladies, isn't it?
Oh, never mind. You've time to spare, no?
Shall we judge the jewels together, you and I?
Hehe, I stole the shopkeeper's line.
note: Idiom 'steal the shopkeeper's thunder': she greeted the player with the shopkeeper's 'welcome' (#4032).

en: You've come again today.
Strolling, dressing up, gazing at jewels,
day after day: what do you think of that?
Let me tell you: it's boring me to death.
Oh, you really do come often.
Since you started coming to the shop,
I've been a little less bored.
I'm thinking of changing my rounds soon.
Where to, I wonder... The hat shop, perhaps.
Oh, who are you?
The Baron? He's in the courtyard.
I've no business with you myself...
Do go and look in the courtyard.
Is there something you want of me?
I'm sorry, I'm busy just now.
What is it? Have you business with the Baron?
Right now he's
admiring the beauties in the street, I'd say.
The Baron? Right now he's
admiring the beauties in the street.
Go now and you might join the Baron in his
game of spotting beauties, you know?
How good of you to come.
Please, won't you be my friend?
I've few people to talk to, and I'm bored.
I used to be a servant, you know.
So I know all sorts of things.
Lots of amusing stories, too.
I shall put an end to your dull days.
Offer up your life to me...
Just right for humans who live without purpose.
I shall give you a calling.
Good morning. Can I help you?
I can't help speaking to a beautiful lady.
Have I offended you, perhaps?
I've nothing to do today either,
note: Ends with a comma: #8525 (slice 106) must continue in lowercase ('so I'll kill time...').

en: No, we've never met.
I always make a point of greeting
a beautiful lady.
Farewell for now, Henrietta.
Good day, lovely madam.
And you? Looking for new jewelry?
...Is that so?
I hope we meet again, Henrietta.
(Everyone has their own circumstances...)
Are you looking for new jewelry?
Truth is, I came hoping
to see you, Henrietta.
admiring the beauties in the street, I'd say.
If you go now, you too might get to join
the Baron's game of spotting beauties,
who knows?
...I love you...
note: Rose speaking in delirium; the 'you' she loves is unclear and kept vague.

en: Who... are you?
...Her breathing is labored.
She's gravely ill...
...At this rate,
she won't last much longer.
Even that lovely face will wither in death...
Every life has its end...
...I don't... want to die... yet...
She's lost consciousness...
This woman hasn't long to live.
Unless I drink her blood, that is.
note: Same line as #8636 after a pause.

en: Rose...
W-who... are you?
